explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. I did not grep Mathlib, because every main constant in the statement is defined by the library itself and has no counterpart in Mathlib. These are `JZero`, `Pic0`, `Pic0.torsion`, `Pic0.congr`, `reductionModL`, `heckeGen`, `heckeModuleBar`, `heckeOperatorBar`, `frobeniusPushforwardModL` and `modularFunctionFieldC`. The theorem is an Eichler–Shimura-type congruence for the Jacobian of the modular curve X_0(M). The proof chains several of the library's own lemmas: `heckeModuleBar_heckeGen_smul`, `reductionModL_heckeOperatorBar`, `reductionInputsModL_of_not_dvd` and `heckeOperatorModL_eq_frobeniusPushforwardModL_of_natCast_smul_eq_zero`. The only Mathlib facts it uses are generic ones (`map_zsmul`, `map_zero`, `AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply`), which do not count. All of the mathematical content sits in the library's definitions.
